svg.title: About Nachiketh Sudhindra Kadkol
svg.desc: I build the data foundation behind better decisions. Analytics Engineer at SAGO, previously BI Analyst at Diacto Technologies, M.S. from UMass Amherst. Animated pipeline: raw data, SQL transformations, data models, data quality, analytics insights. Sample SQL and checks are illustrative.

g.text: Analytics Engineer specializing in SQL, data modeling,
ETL/ELT pipelines, data quality and reporting automation.
I turn business and research data into reusable datasets
and automated reporting workflows with consistent logic.
